description: Na₃CuO₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_12_12 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.42 Å) and two longer (2.57 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.54 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (2.50 Å) and two longer (2.58 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.81 Å. Cu is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. Both Cu-O bond lengths are 1.81 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Cu atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Cu atom.
